retention.stated: Unlimited pages and unlimited uploaded images; no account-level byte quota. Each page is an independent object with a permanent URL

egress.terms: Free and unmetered, images served from telegra.ph CDN paths with no auth and no hotlink limit. Same infrastructure Telegram uses.

tooling: Telegraph API (api.telegra.ph): createAccount, createPage, editPage, getPage, getPageList, getViews. Wrappers: github.com/TABmk/telegraph-wrapper, python-telegraph, many Telegram bots.
chaining: createAccount calls carry no stated limit (probe returned a fresh access_token instantly, no email), pages carry no stated limit, and each image is ~5 MB. Pages are editable indefinitely, so content is mutable in place.
limits_note: ~5 MB per image (JPEG/PNG/GIF/MP4). Uploads are multipart POST to https://telegra.ph/upload, NOT an api.telegra.ph method, and it is not part of the official API. The python-telegraph client's own wording for that is 'NOT PART OF OFFICIAL API, USE AT YOUR OWN RISK', which records that the endpoint is undocumented and unsupported.
